fact: WHO Comoros reports having supported the first quarterly health information bulletins (bulletins trimestriels d'information sanitaire), a quarterly series from the health information system; the report was published 2025-07-10 and gives no date for the bulletins.
The report lists quarterly statistical health information bulletins as disseminated with programme support in 2023; the report was posted in June 2024 and dates no individual bulletin.

The report says a preliminary mission looked at improving the production of foreign and domestic trade statistics from information exchanged between Comoros customs services, and lists the 2023 health statistical yearbook as still to be drafted and validated; the report was posted in June 2024.
system: Statistiques du commerce extérieur (customs exchange) and Annuaire statistique de la santé 2023
